watches.description:
Stylish oval design with premium finish Featuring an elegant oval case shape and a sleek black or brown color option, this men's watch combines classic sophistication with modern aesthetics for a refined look.
Automatic self-winding movement Powered by a reliable automatic self-wind movement, this watch eliminates the need for batteries and ensures continuous operation with natural motion.
Skeleton dial with tourbillon feature The intricate skeleton dial showcases the inner mechanics, while the tourbillon adds a high-end touch, highlighting precision engineering and craftsmanship.
Durable stainless steel band with adjustable fit Crafted from stainless steel band material, the strap offers strength and comfort with a width of 20 to 24 mm and a length of 23 cm for a secure fit.
Water-resistant up to 3Bar With a 3Bar water resistance depth, this watch resists splashes and light immersion, making it suitable for daily wear including handwashing and light rain.

watches.name: OLEVS 9910 Mens Watch Original Luxury Brand Waterproof Luminous Automatic Mechanical Watch Dual Calendar Watch Box Reloj
watches.description:
Luxury mechanical design with automatic movement The OLEVS 9910 men's watch features a premium mechanical hand wind movement for a timeless, self-powered experience with elegant craftsmanship and precision engineering.
Stainless steel build for durability and style Crafted with a stainless steel case and band, this watch offers a sleek, robust design with a case thickness of 13mm and a band width of 20 to 24 mm for a secure, luxurious fit.
Water-resistant up to 3Bar for daily use With a 3Bar water resistance depth, this watch is protected against splashes, rain, and handwashing, making it ideal for everyday wear without compromising on performance or durability.
Enhanced functionality with dual calendar display Equipped with a complete calendar and week display, this mechanical wristwatch provides accurate date tracking and a sophisticated touch for professional and casual settings alike.
Shock-resistant and durable coated glass The coated glass dial window ensures scratch resistance and clarity, while the shock-resistant construction protects the movement from daily impacts and wear.
